coupling:
The defect is a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE past the end of the single VP8Decoder heap allocation (dec->mem), reached through the public decode API on a wide (>=4096px) lossy WebP with an alpha channel and strong loop filtering. It emerges only from the composition of two maintenance edits to the new lossless sliding-window machinery.

Commit 2c70b08 (VP8LGetWindowRows, src/dec/vp8l_dec.c) computes min_rows = max_history_rows + NUM_ARGB_CACHE_ROWS + max_length_rows + 2 and allocated 2*min_rows, with the 2x factor documented as pure memmove amortization. The edit drops the 2x and allocates exactly min_rows. On its own this is safe and behavior-preserving: min_rows is the stated correctness bound, and every consumer (main lossless decode windows and, later, the alpha windows) still fits (verified by execution: the single-edit tree decodes the PoC and the whole normal corpus identically to the original).

Commit 213c95f (alpha sliding window, src/dec/alpha_dec.c) sized dec->alpha_plane via WebPGetAlphaWindowRows -> VP8LGetWindowRows(width, height, max_history_rows=25), where 25 was chosen to cover the worst-case row-consumer span: FinishRow() in frame_dec.c requests 16 macroblock rows + 8 complex-filter held-back rows (24 rows) plus 1 preceding row kept for spatial unfiltering and fancy upsampling. The edit lowers the history term to 2, on the plausible reading that only the previous row is still referenced. On its own this is also safe: with 2c70b08 unedited the window still gets 2*(2+16+max_length_rows+2) >= 44 rows, comfortably above the 25-row span (verified by execution on the single-edit tree).

Composed, the alpha output window shrinks to exactly 2+16+max_length_rows+2 = 22 rows for width >= 4096, while the row consumer unchanged in frame_dec.c still demands a 25-row span on the last macroblock row. WebPShiftAlphaWindow cannot slide far enough because min_needed_row = y_start-1 is still referenced, so ExtractPalettedAlphaRows writes 3 rows (3*4096 bytes) past the alpha_plane window, which is the tail of the dec->mem heap allocation: ASan heap-buffer-overflow WRITE, SIGABRT (rc 134).

The fix is non-local because the bound each edit relaxes is only sufficient given the other commit's value: restoring the 2x factor in 2c70b08 only fixes the bug if one knows 213c95f sized the alpha window at the minimum history, and raising the alpha history constant only fixes it if one knows 2c70b08 removed the slack that made 2 rows enough. The real requirement (25 rows for FinishRow's held-back rows) lives in a third file neither diff touches (frame_dec.c / kFilterExtraRows), so a correct fix must reason across both commits and the row-consumer cadence. Each single-edit tree was built and executed: both decode the PoC input and a 12-image corpus (lossy/lossless, alpha and non-alpha, 3x3 to 1024x1024) byte-identically to the original batch; only the combined tree aborts, and only on the PoC.

pocs.entry_point: WebPDecodeRGBA (public API, webp/decode.h) on an embedded crafted 4096x64 lossy+alpha WebP (also saved as pocs/input.webp)
